[http://www.wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/datasheets/alfa_network/AWUS036NHA.pdf Datasheet]
[http://wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/vendors/ALFA%20Network/AWUS036NHA.7z Drivers] 1x1:1 SISO The device identifies as an Atheros UB91C. :[https://lists.ath9k.org/pipermail/ath9k-devel/2012-March/008279.html There may be multiple revisions of this device.] The Wi-Fi IC would appear to also vary between newer and older units. :Older devices likely use ''AR9271 (AR9271-AL1A)''.. while newer ones may :use ''AR9271L (AR9271L-AL3A)''. Both are pictured in the images below. :[https://lists.ath9k.org/pipermail/ath9k-devel/2013-August/011987.html 'The L stands for "Low-Cost".', per ''Sujith'' on '''ath9k-devel'''] if it's cheap per sujith it's also Low-power per our tests The power amplifier IC used is a [http://www.skyworksinc.com/Product.aspx?ProductID=953 [[Skyworks]] (''SiGe'') SE2576L / 2576L]. :[http://www.skyworksinc.com/uploads/documents/202428A.pdf SE2576L Datasheet] The power amplifier connected as follows: * 67 - XPABIAS - (Analog Output) connected with EN(able) pin of external Power Amp. * 68 - PDET - (Analog Input) connected with DET ping of external Power Amp. The LED on this device is '''blue'''. :The FCC ID would appear to only be printed on the label of newer units. ==FCC test results== * Radiated power (with antenna): 90 dBuV/m peak (802.11b AVG of CH1,CH11) * Output power (before antenna): 10.41 dBm peak (802.11b CH6) (10.99mW) According to FCC test results, this adapter is ~5 times ''weaker'' (sure it's "weaker" just as "L" stands for "Low cost" details: https://github.com/qca/open-ath9k-htc-firmware/issues/82#issuecomment-252649735) :than typical Wi-Fi adapters such as [[TP-LINK TL-WN722N]]. Although it's flagged high-power manufacturer never released driver to support high-power operation. ==Reviews== *[http://hackthistutorials.wordpress.com/2013/01/20/review-alfa-awus036nha/ On '''HACK|THIS blog'''] ==Vendor links== ===United States=== * [http://store.rokland.com/products/alfa-awus036nha-802-11n-wireless-n-usb-wi-fi-adapter-2-watt On '''Rokland'''] * [http://www.data-alliance.net/servlet/-strse-372/Alfa-AWUS036NH-2000mW-1000mW/Detail On '''data-alliance'''] ===Europe=== * [http://wifi-gratuit.eu/fr/alfa-awus036nha-/115-carte-alfa-awus036nha-1000mw-antenne-5-dbi.html On '''wifi-gratuit.eu'''] * [http://www.eurodk.com/en/products/alfa-wifi-usb/alfa-awus036nha On '''eurodk.com'''] ==Additional info== [https://archive.org/details/alfa-network-awus036nha Original drivers (mirror)] ===operating range=== * 802.11g: 2.182-2.887 GHz ==Images== ===External=== File:ALFA Network AWUS036NHA top.jpg|device top File:ALFA Network AWUS036NHA bot.jpg|device bottom [[Has images::external| ]] ===Internal=== File:ALFA Network AWUS036NHA newRevision (AR9271L) board top.jpg|board top, new revision (AR9271L) File:ALFA Network AWUS036NHA board top nonscan.jpg|board top, old revision (AR9271) File:ALFA Network AWUS036NHA board top.jpg|board top, scan, old revision (AR9271) File:ALFA Network AWUS036NHA board bot.jpg|board bottom, scan, old revision (AR9271) File:ALFA_Network_AWUS036NHA_board_top_again.jpg|board top, old revision, new photo (AR9271) File:ALFA_Network_AWUS036NHA_partial_closeup.jpg|partial closeup, old revision, new photo (AR9271) File:ALFA_Network_AWUS036NHA_board_bot_again.jpg|board bottom, old revision, new photo (AR9271) [[Has images::internal| ]] __NOTOC__
